Appearance

Burly man with a broad chest and dark slicked-back hair. Wears a dark steel breastplate with an iron gauntlet emblem and a crimson half-cloak.

What We Know

Leader of the Nightstalkers adventuring party. A regular patron at the Sturdy Mugg. Wields iron-knuckled gauntlets in combat.

First Impressions

Commands attention the moment he enters a room — broad-shouldered and confident.

Interactions

  • Found alive in the mines — reluctantly rescued by the party
  • Drew the party a map of Mine Level 3 at the church
